title: What one seems to see is the intentional object of a conviction, not its cause

statements.text: In an afterimage of a red stripe there is no red stripe anywhere. A cortical representation causes the conviction, and the red stripe is the intentional object of that conviction, a fiction of a sort, with no figment as the stuff of phenomenal properties.

sources.quote: The red stripe you seem to see is not the cause or source of your convictions but the intentional object of your convictions.
we shouldn’t postulate figment as the stuff of ‘phenomenal properties’
